entities.name: Abbasid Caliphate
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Abbasid Caliphate, a political institution in Oman during Early Islamic Oman and Ibadi Imamate (750–1154). Grew from Sohar becomes one of the great entrepôts of the Indian Ocean world and Al-Julanda bin Masud elected as the first Ibadi Imam of Oman.
